item.title: github: Dependabot alerts REST API now includes dependency versions
item.description:
Dependabot alerts REST API responses now include the vulnerable dependency’s version directly. A new version_requirement field has been added to each alert’s dependency object.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Improved detection for withdrawn Dependabot alerts
item.description:
GitHub improved how withdrawn Dependabot alerts are identified. When an advisory or vulnerability is no longer valid, Dependabot now withdraws and removes the alert, and these changes make that state easier to detect.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Agentic autofix now uses Copilot Memory
item.description:
Agentic autofix now checks Copilot Memory when that feature is enabled, using existing memories as context to help resolve security alerts.

  • Source: GitHub
